subject: Welcome to the Community!
author: ZombieTron
body:
It looks like you have successfully joined to me! 🙂

Getting number 1's on crash junctions is probably next to impossible now! But, keep trying... you never know!! I haven't played crash for ages, I have forgotten most of the junctions... might be fun to have a go at them again sometime!

I Love Snow! It's snowing again today, might take us a while to dig the car out before we can go anywhere!!

Thanks for your comments! 😃
